notes.title: Chapter 0: Descent into madness
notes.notes:
We present to you the first downloadable content for THE ORIGIN: Blind Maid - "Chapter 0: Descent into Madness" Expansion. 

It will be FREE for everyone on April 22nd on Steam, on PlayStation 4 and 5.

notes.title: The Politician #RoadToTHEORIGIN
notes.notes:
[Characters]
The Politician (Leo Wiggins)

Main character of the video game THE ORIGIN: Blind Maid. Reflection of a nefarious character that you know who is still in power these days. This character is characterized by being selfish and quite arrogant.

He was indicted for acts of corruption, money laundering, etc. Within the game you can redeem your character, but in real life do characters like these deserve redemption? Who are the ones who can judge these kinds of people? It's still like in the video game, only we can.

#RoadToTHEORIGIN

notes.title: The Farm #RoadToTHEORIGIN
notes.notes:
Torres's Farm - The point of no return

It was founded in 1940 by Don Cancio Torres, grandfather of Ing. Torres, current owner of the ranch.

Since its foundation, events that are classified as paranormal have occurred since it tells the story of the place where the souls of the Guarani natives who were eliminated during the Chaco War rest on its soils.

This cursed ground will be one of the locations to discover.

#RoadToTHEORIGIN

notes.title: Timeline #RoadToTHEORIGIN
notes.notes:
Gravedigger's Journal - Fragment

For centuries the great human minds have tried to reach the essence of all evil: plagues, diseases, human nature itself, the exact moment when evil exists: THE ORIGIN.

When human justice has been totally corrupted, there will be Divine Justice very close to THE ORIGIN to take care of the helpless and eternally condemn the guilty.

THE ORIGIN is, in turn, the end of all evil.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38718953/ae44fc09c6b1d0e52ce6090e6ae0830f66178a1b.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Timeline #RoadToTHEORIGIN
notes.notes:
Since ancient times, many philosophers have interpreted evil as the opposite of good, an abstract and interpretive concept. However, in many writings of alchemists since the twelfth century they speak that evil is not abstract, they have even affirmed that it exists, that it is a localized entity with an epicenter and that it can alter the reality around it. Its provenance is unknown.

[i]Timeline*
1864 - Beginning of the War of the Triple Alliance
1869 - THE ORIGIN
1932 - The Chaco War begins
1989 - Stroessner government falls
2013- Mayor of Asunción flees from justice[/i]

* Many events cited here are fictitious.
